nom: TATCHA The Milky Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some who are also acne-prone, consistently report the sunscreen absorbs fully without adding shine, oiliness, or a greasy feel.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or normal-to-dry skin report a hydrating, glowy finish; one reviewer notes that those with drier skin should still apply a regular moisturizer underneath.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who are also acne-prone or textured, overwhelmingly report no irritation, stinging, or breakouts.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including some who are also acne-prone or dealing with redness, report it hydrates dry areas while controlling oil, without irritation.
segments.normal: The reviewers with normal or normal-to-dehydrated skin describe the formula as comfortable and non-drying.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers report the sunscreen helps fine lines look less noticeable with consistent use, in addition to its sun protection.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly describe the formula as hydrating rather than drying, including several with normally dry or dehydration-prone skin.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report the sunscreen helps calm or visibly reduce redness over time, with several specifically noting less noticeable redness or a more even-looking complexion.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers note ingredients like vitamin E and ectoin that they say help support the skin barrier while providing hydration.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report dark spots and sun damage becoming less noticeable or not worsening with consistent daily use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with acne-prone skin, report no new breakouts and sometimes faster healing of existing blemishes; one reviewer with acne-prone skin found it was not a good match for her skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers across oily, combination, and even dry skin types consistently report the sunscreen absorbs completely without leaving a greasy or oily residue.

aspects.libelle: Milky, fluid texture, easy to apply
No white cast, even on deeper skin tones

extraits.texte: complimentary from tatcha. I wanted to love this sunscreen, but it's definitely not for acne prone skin. It works well for normal to dry skin. The texture is very lightweight and hydrating so it looks good on her makeup! If you don't have sensitive skin, definitely give it a try.

extraits.titre: I've changed my mind about spf
extraits.texte: I have very oily acne prone skin (hormonal acne) ans i hate hate hate spf I've always dreaded having to use spf because of the texture, smell, everything but I understand how important it is. This product has the most beautiful glow WITHOUT LOOKING OILY. The smell is hardly noticeable the texture is perfect. It feels like nothing on the skin and i can actually notice a difference in my skin texture using it over time including the healing time of my hormonal acne and scars. I ADORE this product its sits perfectly under my makeup and works with my other skin care. I couldn't imagine myself not using this. Thank you Tatcha for being so innovative now i need 16 more of them.

This is sensitive skin approved! I love how light this sunscreen is and it didn't break me out which is nice b/c most other face sunscreens do. I also really feel like this sunscreen has helped lighten some of my dark spots and sun damage. gifted by tatcha

I've been trying out the new Tatcha The Milky Sunscreen and I'm obsessed! My skin is usually dry and sensitive, so SPF is always hit or miss but this one is such a win. It's super lightweight, really hydrating, and leaves my skin with the prettiest soft, dewy glow without ever feeling greasy. I've even noticed my skin feels more hydrated throughout the day when I wear it. So grateful to be gifted by Tatcha ✨ I highly recommend trying this one is definitely worth it. Complimentary from Tatcha 🤍

extraits.titre: Love this gentle and lightweight sunscreen!
extraits.texte: I've been using The Milky Sunscreen SPF 50+ for a couple of weeks now and I really love it!! The texture is super lightweight and hydrating, and it blends into my skin so easily with no white cast. It leaves my skin looking glowy and fresh without feeling greasy, and it works really well under makeup for that soft, dewy finish. I have combination, acne-prone skin and some redness, so I'm pretty careful with SPF, but this one has been really gentle and hasn't irritated my skin at all. I've also noticed my skin looking a bit more even, and some of my dark spots seem slightly lighter. I used this every day on my trip to St. Barths and was in the sun for hours, and my skin stayed protected the whole time with no burning. It's definitely something I'll keep using daily :) complimentary from tatcha

I've been using the new Milky SPF 50+ gifted by Tatcha daily. It's quickly become one of my favorite sunscreens. The texture is milky, like its name suggested, spreads easily and feels lightweight on the skin. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a greasy finish. I spend a lot of time outdoors for walks and sports, so sun protection is really important for me. I like that this formula includes ectoin and vitamin E, which help keep my skin hydrated while also supporting the skin barrier. After using it consistently, my skin looks more even and calm overall. Some redness and older sun-related dark spots appear less noticeable, and my skin stays hydrated throughout the day. It's a sunscreen that feels comfortable, protective, and easy to wear every day.

Love the added vitamin E aspect as I just hit 30! Anything to help prevent wrinkles is a bonus. This felt lightweight, absorbed right into the skin and left a dewy finish, not too glossy or greasy. I have oily/acne prone skin. The scent is that classic sweet tatcha! Complimentary from tatcha
